title: Shanghai's River Cruise Is $17. Locals Cross for 30¢ | China Travel Expert
description:
Shanghai's tourist Huangpu River cruise costs about 120 yuan (~$17). The local commuter ferry crosses the exact same river — same Bund, same Pudong skyline — for just 2 yuan, around 30 US cents.

The ferry runs every ~15 minutes and takes about 10 minutes, with both skylines in full view. It's one of the best-value rides in any major city on Earth — a roughly 60x price gap for nearly the same view.

🧭 Expert Tip: Board at the Jinling East Road or Dongchang Road pier and tap in with your metro/transit card (or Alipay). Skip the pricey sightseeing boat unless you specifically want the narrated night cruise.
